ECI Software Accused of Auto-Generating Voter Deletion Forms in UP

Reports allege that the Election Commission of India's (ECI) software, known as UP SIR, auto-generated 85,854 forms for voter deletions in Uttar Pradesh without providing a reason. The Reporters' Collective reported that these forms were generated to delete voters without cause, while National Herald questioned if the ECI software auto-generated these deletion forms.
